result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: Licensee may terminate on 30 days' written notice, prepaid fees attributable to the post-termination period are refunded, and Licensor receives no convenience-termination right during the committed term. However, allowing termination “in whole or in part” and stating that termination creates no “other liability” go beyond the playbook and could affect scope, accrued obligations, or other unrelated liabilities. The margin comment also inaccurately references change-of-control and wind-up rights not shown in the original clause, though that does not undermine the operative amendment.
